title: Flue agent test gap matrix
description: Incident→existing test→gap→new test→priority matrix with a concrete release gate. Uses actual repo findings and file:line evidence.

testMatrix.existing_tests: projectTaskActivity projection tests; ledger unit tests (src/observability/task-activity.test.ts; src/durable-objects/task-ledger.test.ts)
testMatrix.what_they_prove: Observability mapping and durable bookkeeping (claim/dispatch flows)
testMatrix.gap: No unit/integration tests for processTaskMessage (pre-dispatch release, post-dispatch 'uncertain') or cloudflare.queue retry finalization
testMatrix.new_test: src/tasks/processor.test.ts: (1) success; (2) pre-dispatch failure -> ledger.releaseQueueEvent called; (3) post-dispatch failure -> 'uncertain' & failUncertainDispatch. Add cloudflare.queue test for MAX_QUEUE_ATTEMPTS exhaustion.
testMatrix.release_gate: Must have processor pre/post-dispatch tests + cloudflare queue test (see gateSummary 'processor-tests' & 'queue-tests')

testMatrix.existing_tests: ledger claim tests and formatting tests (src/durable-objects/task-ledger.test.ts; src/telegram/format.test.ts)
testMatrix.gap: No channels-level webhook test verifying final webhook reply structure
testMatrix.new_test: src/channels/telegram.test.ts: stub ledger.claimTelegram -> needs_task_request and assert webhook reply { method: 'sendMessage', text contains 'Tap /task' }
testMatrix.release_gate: Optional for immediate hotfix; required before UI changes that affect webhook response format

testMatrix.incident: C — intake/transcription OK but workspace/cleanup problems
testMatrix.existing_tests: interpretTaskIntake audio tests; readResponseBodyWithLimit streaming tests (src/tasks/intake.test.ts; src/telegram/files.test.ts)
testMatrix.gap: stageTelegramAttachments (write into sandbox) and completeGeneralTask (delivery + sandbox.destroy) are not unit-tested
testMatrix.new_test: src/telegram/files.test.ts: stageTelegramAttachments behavior; src/tools/task-tools.test.ts: completeGeneralTask happy/failure (delivery failure -> record activity, sandbox.destroy called)
testMatrix.release_gate: Must have completeGeneralTask delivery tests and artifact persistence assertions (gateSummary 'tools-delivery')

testMatrix.incident: D — previous output cannot be recovered
testMatrix.existing_tests: ledger listing, logs selection, formatting tests (src/durable-objects/task-ledger.test.ts; src/telegram/format.test.ts)
testMatrix.gap: No tests for publishDraftPullRequest and retention model (sandbox.destroy removes files; lack of durable artifact test)
testMatrix.new_test: src/tools/task-tools.test.ts: publishDraftPullRequest happy path + notification failure path; retention-model test asserting sandbox.destroy removes workspace while ledger retains PR URL/metadata
testMatrix.release_gate: Must include publish/persistence tests and a retention-model assertion (gateSummary 'publish-tests' & 'retention-test')

gateSummary.notes: processor pre/post-dispatch unit tests (src/tasks/processor.test.ts) must pass
publishDraftPullRequest + completeGeneralTask delivery/failure tests must pass
stageTelegramAttachments unit tests recommended before broad changes to attachments
test demonstrating retention vs sandbox destroy semantics (policy decision)

props.content: Job: present a dense, actionable matrix mapping each incident to the existing tests that touch it, the precise gaps, the new tests to write, and the priority. Include an explicit release gate (what must land before rolling a fix).

props.caption: Incident → tests → gaps → new tests → priority

# Release gate for reliability patch
